title: Explicit recommendation request after proactive completion
goal: Explore a customer who completes the available proactive recommendation journey and later explicitly asks for another recommendation relevant to the current basket.
preconditions: Use a fresh D1 session with the deterministic synthetic customer authority demo-qualification-07-explicit-request and naturally reach completion of the available proactive recommendation placements.
The customer later initiates a new explicit recommendation request.
The role-player improvises the request from the observed cart and conversation.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Sau khi chọn xong, nếu mình chủ động hỏi thì bạn vẫn tư vấn món hợp với giỏ hiện tại nhé.

risks: Once-only proactive controls must not be confused with a later customer-authored request.
An explicit request still must respect eligibility, merchandising, and trusted mutation boundaries.
